posts.cooked:
My specific doubt is on the topic: File Handling, more specifically, merging a list of files

My doubt is: The task was to merge a list of files line by line, but while solving it I got a different set of output. The first was a new line at the end, and the second was this. As you guys can see, I have stored the lines of the files in a list, all_lines, and trying to store it line by line in outfile, but it is not working

Recommended:
Mention what you have done till now to find clarification on the doubt. Try to append manually, but a new line appears at the end, tried storing in a list, but unable to get the expected output

posts.name: Livin Nector
posts.cooked:
You have to right all files only once right? There is no need for for-loop while writing to file. that is why the output is repeated.

Also you should note that since you are trying to merge three files, the simpler code would be.

def merge_files(file_list,output_file):
    with open(output_file, 'w') as out_file:
        for file_name in file_list:
            with open(file_name, 'r') as in_file:
               content = in_file.read()
            out_file.write(content)
            if content[-1] !='\n':
                out_file.write('\n') # at the end of the file if needed
